title: Coast Guard River Flood Rescues
description: An MH-65 Dolphin aircrew from Coast Guard Air Station Port Angeles hoists two people from the roof of a flooded home in Sumas, Washington, [date]. The crew responded to catastrophic flooding in northwestern Washington and transferred the survivors to a nearby landing zone for EMS care. The rescue swimmer remained at the home during the initial hoists and was later recovered by an Air Station Astoria MH-60 Jayhawk crew. (U.S. Coast Guard courtesy video)
